data.completion_memo: Implemented an argv-only hermetic process runner for approved shell/Python adapters with bounded arguments/output, explicit working directory, and pre-spawn deadline rejection. cargo test -p aworkit-capability-host passes.
data.description: Implement the platform-neutral process lifecycle over an Aworkit PlatformProcessPort with a hermetic conformance adapter: bounded deadlines, sanitized spawn, cooperative cancellation, forced timeout, health, and descendant cleanup. Build approved shell and Python tool adapters on that substrate with exact authority modes and bounded I/O. Native Windows, macOS, and Linux process ports are owned by M12.2.
data.title: M05.2 — Implement invocation process lifecycle, shell, and Python adapters
